title: Sirius & Orion
extract:
Release Date: June 17th, 2026 
Shining bright an emerald light, blazing wild his crimson starfire, twin bleak futures ignite from beyond Origin's past. Constellations shift in celestial realignment, bearing witness to the star-crossed personas' eternal feud. Fight valiantly and take flight as Sirius, guided by mother's prideful flame that uplifts comrades from death's embrace. Strike true and slay fiercely as Orion, enraged with father's relentless wrath, dooming foes to gravity's grasp. Destinies collide when Sirius & Orion, the Dueling Sons, clash in their rebellious ultimatum of cosmic consequence. The twins soared across the cosmos in Update 43.0 (2026-06-17): Jade Shadows: Constellations.
 Sirius & Orion are a pair of constellation-themed Warframes, customizable in the Arsenal separately, and switchable and controllable in-game as a singular Warframe with an assisting Specter.

 Sirius takes after  Jade's support.  Coronal Ejection throws an energy scythe forward that deals  Heat damage and boomerangs back any pickups.  Jade Stars summons a crown of motes that flies towards enemies to deal  Heat damage and recovers motes over time.  Light's Sanctuary creates a dome with healing, Damage Reduction, and revives anyone that enters Bleedout with a cooldown.
 Orion walks in the footsteps of  Stalker's lethality.  Gravitic Slash performs a powerful slice that deals  Slash damage and strips enemy Armor and Shields. If damage is received while in  Astral Shell it creates a projection with heightened Threat Level.  Event Horizon summons a mobile black hole that  Ragdoll and pulls enemies toward it.
Their Passive has switching provide the next two abilities with increased  Ability Efficiency, as well as stealing energy from each other when casting abilities while below 50 energy. The abilities they cast fuels a gauge to activate  Celestial Clash, their ultimate rivalry where Sirius and Orion begin to float into the air and collide their attacks to deal massive radial damage to their surroundings.

Acquisition
Sirius & Orion's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. Their component blueprints are obtained from Scoria's Angel or The Kuva Wytch on Uranus Proxima via Empyrean Railjack.
Alternatively, the blueprints can also be purchased from Hunhow in Pontis Tower with  Emerald Talent or  Crimson Talent, awarded from The Kuva Wytch and Scoria's Angel respectively in quantities of 12-16 (18-22 on The Steel Path) from mission completion plus shooting down targets from the Orowyrm/Ramsled minigame. Each component blueprint requires 90 and the main blueprint requires 275, totaling 545 Emerald/Crimson Talents.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

Notes
Though presented as two separate Warframes, Sirius & Orion occupy a single Warframe slot.
Sirius & Orion have separate upgrade menus, allowing them to have different Mods, Auras, Arcane Enhancements, and other features. For more information, see Sirius & Orion/Abilities/Passive.
Only one Orion can be owned, as Orion is technically an Exalted Warframe, regardless of which son is the primary. Rank, upgrades and appearances are shared between all Orions if multiple Sirius & Orions are owned.
Either Sirius or Orion will be the Primary Son. The Primary Son depends on which name was chosen at the end of Jade Shadows, but can be freely changed after completing Jade Shadows: Constellations via Pontis Tower. If Jade Shadows is not completed and the Warframe is acquired through other means (such as being purchased with  Platinum), Sirius becomes the default Primary Son.
Whichever Primary Son is selected will be the one initially controlled upon landing in a mission. The other becomes the Secondary Son, functioning as an invulnerable AI-controlled ally similar to a Specter and continue to attack enemies.
Only the Primary Son can receive the Helminth Cyst, and the Secondary Son cannot be used nor swapped in player hubs.
Currently,  Pride and  Wrath both lack a Signature Weapon bonus with Sirius & Orion.
If Stalker, Shadow Stalker, or Protector Stalker appears in the mission via Death Mark and Sirius & Orion are present, the Stalker has unique dialogue to their presence ("Show me you've learned") before attacking.
Weapons equipped by Sirius & Orion will have their appearances assigned differently (e.g. if config A is the chosen initial appearance for the weapon and Sirius is the Primary Son, the weapon he holds will appear as config A, while config B is wielded by Orion when swapped during a mission; if config B is chosen as the initial look, Orion's weapons use config C instead).

Trivia
Sirius & Orion are together the 65th unique Warframe to be released.
Orion and Sirius are two characters from Greek mythology that represent a huntsman and his faithful companion.
In mythology, the duo was immortalized in the heavens as the constellation Orion, and the star Sirius, also known as the Dog Star, which is the brightest star in the night's sky and part of the constellation Canis Major. The two are depicted in an eternal chase with the constellation of The Hare. These designations are still recognized by the International Astronomical Union, and can be observed in the Northern Hemisphere.
During Devstream 196 which revealed their abilities, players compared Sirius & Orion to  Equinox due to their similar form-switching playstyle and having associated moves for each form. [DE]Rebecca clarifies their differences by addressing Equinox is like Zelda and Sheik from The Legend of Zelda as being the same person with different identities, whereas Sirius & Orion are two co-existing entities separate from each other.
Unlike Equinox requiring two Neuroptics, Chassis, and Systems to build her, Sirius & Orion's component parts are considered one item (e.g. "Sirius & Orion Neuroptics").
Sirius & Orion are the second Warframes after  Sevagoth and  Sevagoth's Shadow that consists of two separately moddable "Exalted" Warframes with distinct abilities between them.
Sirius & Orion are the fourth Warframes after  Protea,  Dante, and  Jade with a built-in  Universal polarity.
However, in their case it is among their normal polarities instead of their Aura, though it can be moved to the Aura slot after Polarization.
According to Pablo during Devstream 196, this is due to them inheriting it from Jade.
Lore-wise, Sirius & Orion are the first confirmed Warframes to be created during the modern "Warframe Era". All other Warframes with known origins are mostly created during the Orokin Era (except  Temple, who was created during 1999). They are also the third ones after  Excalibur Umbra and  Stalker whose original selves remain alive at the current time period (although Umbra did briefly get killed until he was rebuilt).
Despite this, their playable versions are still copies of them as with most other Warframes, unlike Umbra who is the original.
The original  Jade also survived the modern era until she died giving birth to Sirius/Orion, while a few others such as  Chroma,  Kullervo,  Follie and  Nokko remains debatable whether their original selves are still active or not.
Sirius & Orion are currently the only known Warframes to have never been human, having been born as Warframes due to Jade having been converted while pregnant.
As Jade's sons, they inherit their mother's two aura passive. In gameplay, this is both Warframes having a single Aura slot each that is active simultaneously. Two of the same Aura mod will not stack their effects, but two different Auras will apply as expected.
Unlike Jade's unique interaction wherein  Stalker will instantly despawn rather than attack the squad if someone is playing her, he will still attack the squad if Sirius & Orion are present, with a unique dialogue line instead of his usual taunt.
Sirius & Orion technically do not have alternate helmets, instead being able to wear each other's helmets. This makes them the first Warframes since the original batch not to release with alternate helmets.
Sirius & Orion both perform Emotes upon selection, including Handshake emote when directly facing each other.
If "Friendly Fire" is activated in Simulacrum, the Secondary Son may prioritise attacking the Primary Son over any spawned enemies. The Secondary Son briefly stops attacking if  Celestial Clash is used.

Bugs
When using  Ghost, it will function normally on the controlled Warframe, breaking invisibility when using weapons or through other means - however, when doing so and then switching to the uncontrolled Warframe, they will remain invisible indefinitely regardless of weapons used, abilities used, or enemy proximity.
When Ghost's cooldown ends, if the visible Warframe is switched to, they will turn invisible again. This resets the interaction, allowing either Warframe to break invisibility again and render the other invisible indefinitely.
Rapidly swapping between the two twins while moving will cause a burst of acceleration that stacks every time one twin kicks out the other. This results in incredible speed when done a number of times.
In the Perita Rebellion, Sirius & Orion will become input locked occasionally when the timer expires, resulting in both twins (though not companions) being rendered invincible. Both the uncontrolled twin and the companion (if modded for attacking) will be able to attack the boss but the player will be entirely input locked and must force close the game as menu inputs are also locked.
If going through a portal in Sanctuary Onslaught while using Celestial Clash the player will become able to only walk and aim in one of the twins, ending the mission fixes the issue.
Sirius & Orion's noble idle animation causes their fingers to clip through the  Grimoire
